findings.title: Demo fixture is a dangling gitlink; every clone is empty
findings.description: examples/demo-repo was committed as a gitlink (160000) to 31b94fc with no .gitmodules and no reachable object. npm run setup / npm run demo fail with 'Demo source files are missing'; 5 backend tests fail or error; the Docker image copies an empty directory.
evidence: clean clone: setup exit 1 after 455 s (08-runtime-startup.md)
findings.recommended_action: Restore the 11 fixture sources (setup_demo rebuilds v2 == 31b94fc exactly); pin LF

findings.title: E003 commit broke verify_retrieval for callers without dense_windows
findings.description: args.dense_windows read unconditionally: test_verify_retrieval (2 failed) and test_analyze_baseline (5 errors). Introduced by this engagement's own E003 commit 95953a4.
findings.recommended_action: getattr with a None default

findings.title: Nonsense queries presented as 'the relevant code'
findings.description: Dense retrieval always returns nearest neighbours (cosine 0.11-0.15 for 'qxzjvnonexistentidentifier'); the UI headed them 'Here's the relevant code'.
findings.recommended_action: Add match_basis; honest heading

findings.title: Rejected E002 cross-encoder still reachable in the product; misleading availability flag
findings.description: ASTFLOW_RERANKER_ENABLED (undocumented) routed search through a model that lowered NDCG@10 by 0.0187 (CI excludes 0); CROSS_ENCODER_AVAILABLE=True was written into manifests.
findings.recommended_action: Remove from the product; reject unknown modes

findings.title: No MTEB artifact for the current code
findings.description: results/mteb, mteb-bm25, mteb-hybrid came from three older code states (0.089 / 0.06104 / 0.08815).
findings.recommended_action: Generate artifacts for the current code

findings.title: Call graph essentially empty on real repositories
findings.description: Every call inside a nested function was rejected: express 12 edges / 3,120 callables (99.3% isolated), lodash 20 / 4,463.
findings.recommended_action: Resolve identifier calls from nested scopes via the scope-chain lookup; verify with the TS language service

findings.title: Critical ARIA violation in every view
findings.description: role=tablist contained close buttons (aria-required-children) in 21/21 crawled states.
findings.recommended_action: Labelled group + aria-current

findings.title: Uncaught page error when leaving the Compare diff
findings.description: 'TextModel got disposed before DiffEditorWidget model got reset' in 10 crawl interactions (all viewports).
findings.reproduction: Compare, then click a source link
findings.recommended_action: keepCurrentOriginalModel / keepCurrentModifiedModel

findings.title: MTEB artifact scored a tie-broken order ASTFLOW never returns
findings.description: Raw RRF scores tie inside the top 10 for ~9% of queries; MTEB re-sorted ties: NDCG@10 0.089 / MRR@10 0.07338 vs 0.0884 / 0.07257 for the actual order.
findings.recommended_action: Emit rank-preserving scores (as the trust harness does)

findings.title: Retrieval accuracy on AppsRetrieval is low; candidate generation is the limit
findings.description: Hybrid NDCG@10 0.0884 (Recall@100 0.298); 65% of answers are in neither retriever's top 100; 89% of queries exceed the dense model's 256 word-pieces; median query/document vocabulary overlap 5.8%.
findings.recommended_action: E004 (pre-registered, awaiting approval); E005 candidate (offline NL descriptions)

findings.title: Graph intermittently rendered invisible nodes / no edges
findings.description: After the canvas remounted, React Flow sometimes never measured nodes: nodes stayed hidden, then edges were never drawn (2 of 32 diagnostic traces; studio map test failed 3 of 12 repeats); the canvas also jumped once after render (two fits with different padding).
findings.reproduction: Map -> file focus -> open source -> Trace
findings.recommended_action: fixed node size + declared handles; same fit padding

findings.title: investigation.spec.ts targets a removed UI
findings.description: 6/6 tests fail on .result-card / nav 'Trace' selectors from a deleted component.
findings.recommended_action: Replace with journeys against the current UI

findings.title: Confirmation split used three times during BM25 tuning
findings.description: bm25-tuning-log.json records 3 confirmation runs (k1 1.6 twice, 1.5 once); the ledger requires confirmation once per candidate. The README also claimed the tuning scripts were never run.
findings.recommended_action: Record the breach; correct the README

findings.title: 'Explain' implies generated explanations that do not exist
findings.description: Top-bar Explain toggled a panel; 'Explain this code' ran a search. Generation is out of S1 scope.
findings.recommended_action: Rename to Ask / Find related code

findings.title: Title field re-tokenised every chunk on every query; two unused corpus copies
findings.description: lexical_scores looped over all chunks tokenising qualified_name per query (91.2 ms/query on 8,765 docs).
evidence: scores bit-identical on 300 queries x 8,765 docs; 91.2 -> 1.9 ms/query
findings.recommended_action: Precompute title tokens

findings.title: Frontend source written as very long single lines
findings.description: App.tsx lines up to 1,881 chars; studio.css up to 14,088; Semgrep could only partially parse two files.
findings.recommended_action: Format with a formatter in a dedicated no-behaviour-change commit

findings.title: Trust-harness evaluators not declared as dependencies
findings.description: pytrec_eval / ir_measures imported but in no requirements file; a fresh MTEB venv fails 3 tests.
findings.recommended_action: Pin the versions recorded in the baseline manifest

findings.title: Insufficient contrast (hints, captions, Monaco tokens, highlighted and diff lines)
findings.recommended_action: Raise to >= 4.5:1

findings.title: Baseline-v1 generated from an unpublished dirty commit; '5 evaluators' overstated
findings.description: manifest-baseline-v1 records commit 7df804f8 (not in the repository) with modified search.py/embeddings.py; the manifest shows 4 evaluators.
findings.recommended_action: Reproduce from committed code (done: identical metrics, 0 per-query metric changes) and correct the docs

findings.title: No cross-file edges for CommonJS or member calls
findings.description: express/lodash cross_file_edges = 0 after F-023.
findings.recommended_action: Conservative CommonJS require/exports resolution with a judged precision check

findings.title: Large-repository overview is a grid of unconnected boxes
findings.description: 60 of 141 files, 0 edges at fit-to-screen zoom.
findings.recommended_action: Cluster by directory; show connected files first

findings.title: Companion drawer covers the Compare result and opened sources on narrow screens
findings.description: Controls intercepted at 768/390 px (Playwright: companion subtree intercepts pointer events).
findings.recommended_action: Do not auto-open over the diff; close the drawer when a link is chosen

findings.title: plan() compiled one regex per symbol per query
findings.description: 88% of search time on express (319 ms/query); 498 ms on lodash.
evidence: plan() outputs identical on 36 query/repository pairs
findings.recommended_action: Substring pre-filter

findings.title: Test code crowds results on real repositories
findings.description: express: >= 4 test results in the top 5 for 4 of 8 hand-written questions; test/ directories are not detected as tests.
evidence: audit/evidence/rejected-parser-heuristics.md (probe ran lexical-only: model not in the scratch cache)
findings.recommended_action: Detect test directories without adding test descriptions to the title field; evaluate on a judged set

findings.title: README claims contradicted by evidence
findings.description: Said the tuning scripts never ran (they did); local table produced without the model; the fixture was described as included (it was not); 'Explain' step; no mention of the reranker flag.
findings.recommended_action: Correct the README

findings.title: No CI
findings.recommended_action: Add PR validation and a manual benchmark workflow

findings.title: MTEB runs recorded no code provenance
findings.description: run_metadata.json had no commit.
findings.recommended_action: Record commit + dirty files at start

findings.title: rank() compiled one regex per candidate row
findings.description: The exact-symbol check built a case-insensitive boundary regex for up to 1,000 candidates per query: hybrid rank() 84.6 ms (express) / 93.1 ms (lodash).
findings.recommended_action: casefold substring pre-filter before the unchanged regex

findings.title: Compare-copy test asserted the wrong text
findings.description: The copied 'Before' snippet is a method body without 'AuthService'; a later step used a removed control.
findings.recommended_action: Compare with the displayed snippet; use the Chat button

findings.title: /docs and /redoc render blank
findings.description: Swagger/ReDoc scripts load from cdn.jsdelivr.net; the app's own CSP blocks them.
findings.recommended_action: Disable; keep /openapi.json

findings.title: Agent step named RERANK although it only sorts scores
findings.recommended_action: Rename to RANK

findings.title: Two IndexService instances per CLI process
findings.description: main.py builds a module-level app at import; cli demo builds another.
findings.recommended_action: Make the module-level app lazy or reuse it

findings.title: verify_retrieval recorded git state at the end of a run
findings.description: A 27-minute run recorded a commit made mid-run.
findings.recommended_action: Capture at start

findings.title: favicon.ico 404 on every load
findings.description: Console error; Lighthouse best practices 0.96.
findings.recommended_action: Inline SVG favicon

findings.title: Functions assigned to properties are labelled anonymous@L:C
findings.description: e.g. express res.cookie. A naming fix was prototyped and rejected (it hurt an 8-question retrieval probe).
findings.recommended_action: Use the property path as a display name only (not the BM25 title field) and evaluate

findings.title: Monaco CancellationError surfaced as an unhandled rejection on tab switch
findings.description: Pre-existing (reproduced on the old build).
evidence: diagnostic run on old and new builds
findings.recommended_action: Swallow only Monaco 'Canceled' rejections

findings.title: /api/versions spawns ~15 git processes per call
findings.description: P50 345 ms on the demo; called on every refresh.
findings.recommended_action: Cache per refs state

findings.title: Docker image unverified
findings.description: Docker is not installed on the audit machine.
findings.recommended_action: Build and run on a Docker host

findings.title: Heading levels skipped (h1 -> h3) in answer views
findings.description: axe heading-order (moderate) in 5 of 21 crawled states.
findings.recommended_action: companion title as h2

security_accepted: S-1 no authentication (local single-user tool, loopback only)
S-2 absolute paths and raw git error text in responses
S-3 git honours the target repository's config (no hooks run)
S-5 container process binds all interfaces inside the container
